predictions.selection_reason: node._compile (potentially attacker-controlled) -> safe hasOwnProperty check -> prevents prototype pollution attacks on CustomNodes
predictions.source_summary: CustomNode instances created from user-provided extra_nodes mapping during parsing. The node object comes from parsing user input expressions with custom node handlers.
predictions.sink_summary: node._compile(defs, args) call that executes custom compilation logic defined by user-provided CustomNode classes
predictions.guard_summary: Added hasOwnProperty check prevents prototype pollution by ensuring _compile method is defined directly on the node instance, not inherited from Object.prototype. This complements the existing typeof check for function type.
predictions.risk_pattern: Prototype pollution protection for CustomNode compilation - prevents attacker from polluting Object.prototype with malicious _compile method that would execute when processing any node
predictions.context_summary: Security check added to prevent prototype pollution attacks on CustomNode compilation. CustomNodes are created from user-provided handlers during expression parsing and can define custom _compile methods. The check ensures _compile is defined directly on the node instance.
unresolved_facts: Specific attack vectors that could exploit prototype pollution without this check
Whether CustomNode handlers can be provided by untrusted users in this application context

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Prototype pollution protection for dynamic method invocation on user-controlled objects
retrieval_query.missing_control: hasOwnProperty check to prevent inherited prototype pollution
retrieval_query.impact: arbitrary code execution via polluted Object.prototype

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
top_sast_rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper output encoding based on context (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL). Use Content Security Policy and validate input.
